en.title: Lost Something at a Jeju Restaurant, Café, Beach or Attraction? What to Do
en.desc: Left something at a restaurant, café, beach, attraction or on the Udo ferry in Jeju? How to contact the place in Korean, when it goes to the police, and how to get it back after you leave.
en.h1: Lost Something at a Jeju Restaurant, Café or Attraction
summary: Call the place directly. The phone number is on Kakao Map or Naver Map. If you don't speak Korean, call 1330 for free interpretation.
Small businesses keep items for a short time and may hand valuables to the nearest police box, after which they show up in the police lost-property database.
Not in Jeju anymore? Jeju Live can contact the place in Korean, collect the item and send it to you.

sections.body: Search the place on Kakao Map or Naver Map and call. Give the date, time, table or seat, and a description. Many small places can also be reached by Instagram or KakaoTalk channel. If you paid by card, your card statement shows the exact business name.

Paid attractions (museums, theme parks, observatories) usually have a ticket office or information center that keeps lost items. At beaches and public parks, items are often handed to a lifeguard station, the local community office or the nearest police box. If you don't know who to call, Jeju's 120 Mandeok Call Center (064-120, 07:00–22:00) can point you to the right office.
For items left on the Udo ferry or at the port, contact the Seongsan Port passenger terminal (064-782-5671) and give the sailing time and direction.
Phones, wallets, IDs and cash are often handed to the police. Jeju Live's live search shows Jeju police lost property in English and Chinese; search a few days after the loss.

faq.q: The place doesn't answer the phone.
faq.a: Small shops close on fixed days. Try again during opening hours, message them via Kakao Map or Instagram, or ask Jeju Live to contact them for you.

faq.q: Can Jeju Live collect from a restaurant or café?
faq.a: Yes. Submit a proxy pickup request with the place name and what you left. We contact the place in Korean, collect it and arrange delivery.

zh.title: 在济州餐厅、咖啡店、海边或景点落了东西怎么办
zh.desc: 在济州的餐厅、咖啡店、海水浴场、景点或牛岛渡轮上落了东西？如何用韩语联系店家、什么时候会交给警察、回国后怎么取回。
zh.h1: 在济州餐厅、咖啡店、景点遗失物品
summary: 直接给店家打电话，电话可以在 Kakao 地图或 Naver 地图上查到。不会韩语可以拨打 1330 获得免费中文翻译。
小店保管时间较短，贵重物品可能会交给附近派出所，之后可以在警方失物数据库中查到。
已经离开济州？Jeju Live 可以用韩语联系店家，取回后寄给你。

sections.body: 在 Kakao 地图或 Naver 地图上搜索店名并打电话，说明日期、时间、座位和物品特征。很多小店也可以通过 Instagram 或 KakaoTalk 频道联系。刷卡付款的，信用卡账单上会显示准确的商户名称。
收费景点（博物馆、主题乐园、观景台）一般由售票处或游客中心保管遗失物。海水浴场和公园的物品常被交到救生站、当地社区办公室或附近派出所。不知道该找谁时，拨打济州120万德咨询中心（064-120，07:00–22:00），他们会告诉你该联系哪个部门。
落在牛岛渡轮或码头的物品，请联系城山港综合客运码头（064-782-5671），说明乘船时间和方向。
手机、钱包、证件、现金常会交给警察。Jeju Live 实时失物查询用中文显示济州警方失物数据，丢失几天后去查一下。

faq.a: 小店有固定休息日。营业时间再打，或通过 Kakao 地图、Instagram 留言，也可以请 Jeju Live 代为联系。

faq.q: Jeju Live 能去餐厅、咖啡店代领吗？
faq.a: 可以。提交代领申请，写明店名和落下的物品。我们用韩语联系店家，取回后安排寄送，可通过微信沟通。
